brief.purpose: Review Ravi Chandrasekaran. Lombard facility 1.29pp from a margin call. Then: 89% of the household moves with US technology and AI capital expenditure.
talking_points: Between 2025-12-31 and 2026-08-26 the household moved up USD 2,902,700, or 6.6%, from USD 43,796,500 to USD 46,699,200.
Of that, +USD 1,402,700 came from market moves, +USD 0 from currency translation and +USD 1,500,000 from money paid in or taken out.

Lombard facility 1.29pp from a margin call. CF-0001 sits at 73.71% loan-to-value against a 75% trigger. A 1.7% fall in collateral value is enough to produce a margin call. The trigger was already breached at 2026-06-30. The breach at 2026-06-30 was cured by 2026-08-26 without any repayment: the drawn balance was unchanged and lending value rose by 225,160 USD as the collateral appreciated. The exposure was resolved by the market, not by an action, and would return if the move reversed.
89% of the household moves with US technology and AI capital expenditure. USD 41,357,000 across 5 positions responds to the same driver. The dataset records 1 events on this theme in 2026.

Known obligations of USD 6,200,000 against USD 152,143 the client can actually withdraw. Severe liquidity shortfall of USD 6,047,857: The client has only USD 152,143 in unencumbered, withdrawable cash against USD 6,200,000 in obligations falling due inside the planning horizon (coverage is just 2.5%, driven by tax and commitment payments). While holding USD 13,055,057 in readily realisable liquid securities, these are pledged to the active Lombard facility and cannot be withdrawn without a margin-call breach. The remaining USD 33,492,000 of wealth is illiquid private assets.

USD 31,920,000 (68% of the household) is carried at a mark up to 330 days old. These positions have a valuation_date earlier than the snapshot they appear in. Quarterly-reported private marks lagging a quarter is normal and not an error, but the reported wealth figure is only as current as its oldest input, and any percentage of the household computed against it inherits the lag.

Dear Ravi Chandrasekaran,

Thank you for your time today. A short summary of what we discussed and what happens next.

Where the portfolio stands. Between 2025-12-31 and 2026-08-26 the household moved up USD 2,902,700, or 6.6%, from USD 43,796,500 to USD 46,699,200. Of that, +USD 1,402,700 came from market moves, +USD 0 from currency translation and +USD 1,500,000 from money paid in or taken out.

What we focused on. Lombard facility 1.29pp from a margin call. CF-0001 sits at 73.71% loan-to-value against a 75% trigger. A 1.7% fall in collateral value is enough to produce a margin call. The trigger was already breached at 2026-06-30. The breach at 2026-06-30 was cured by 2026-08-26 without any repayment: the drawn balance was unchanged and lending value rose by 225,160 USD as the collateral appreciated. The exposure was resolved by the market, not by an action, and would return if the move reversed.

What we agreed to look at. Agree a collateral plan before the next client-driven withdrawal: either reduce drawn, add eligible collateral, or accept a smaller withdrawal than the client expects.

Nothing in this note is a recommendation to buy or sell. Any action will be confirmed with you in writing before it is taken, and the figures above are as at 2026-08-26.

Kind regards,
Priscilla Ong
Asia desk - Singapore and Hong Kong booking centres
